references.text: Esau married women from the Hittite people, which was a source of grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
Isaac got a wife from his own people, not from the Canaanites, in accordance with Abraham's wish.
Isaac instructs Jacob not to take a wife from the Canaanites, but from his own people.
Contrast between Rebekah's own origin from Paddan-Aram and her fear that Jacob will marry a Canaanite.
Thematic parallel: Existential crisis linked to childlessness and fear of losing one's foundation in life for both Rebekah and Rachel.
